notes: The waw opening the verse takes the postposed also (rule 51).

Both that's belong to the ki, whose scope covers the coordinated clauses (rules 25, 55's repeated-subordinator clause); the competing reading gives the first to the suffix of vahem under rule 18's relative-pronoun clause, on the model of sarim zahav lahem, and the unit note records it.
hayah is present and takes the hath of the possessive recasting, leaving its preposition unrepresented (rules 40, 43).
